title: Morning Brief — Friday, 30 October 2026
description: Sydney Airport security screeners stage a third round of strikes, Queensland Premier David Crisafulli rules out any deal with One Nation while conceding more work is needed on cost of living, and a Gold Coast council committee caps the chief executive's spending authority at $100 million. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
